title: MITRE ATT&CK, Malpedia and D3FEND reference pages (P300)
notes: Batch p2-G14-2, module pivots_cti. Links under x_module_links need a value transformation, a TLP ceiling or a warning that the frozen core link model does not carry yet: the pack's module renders them (linted like pack links, fail closed). ATT&CK technique pages use {mitre_path} (T1059.001 -> T1059/001: the dotted path answers 404); group and software pages use the G/S id and Malpedia the id from the P295 alias index, never the raw name (an umbrella or ambiguous name gets no link). Order (P300 cond 6): ATT&CK, Malpedia, D3FEND.

links.label: MITRE D3FEND - defences for an ATT&CK technique
links.notes: Dotted ids work (T1059.001, verified 2026-11-26); an unknown id answers 404. Technique ids only: a tactic, mitigation or data-source id (TA/M/DS) has no D3FEND offensive-technique page.

x_module_links.label: MITRE ATT&CK - technique page
x_module_links.notes: T1059.001 -> /techniques/T1059/001/ (verified; the dotted path is 404). A revoked id links its replacement (v3lum.core.attack.canonical) and the label says 'revoked -> replaced by'.

x_module_links.label: MITRE ATT&CK - group page
x_module_links.notes: G id from the P295 alias index (G0007 verified); umbrella or ambiguous names get no link.

x_module_links.label: MITRE ATT&CK - software page
x_module_links.notes: S id from the P295 alias index (S0367 verified).

x_module_links.label: Malpedia - malware family page
x_module_links.notes: Family id '<platform>.<name>' from the P295 alias index (win.emotet verified), never the raw name (P300 cond 9). Manual browsing is unaffected by the API's CC BY-NC-SA licence.

x_module_links.label: Malpedia - threat actor page
x_module_links.notes: Actors live under /actor/{id} (apt28, lazarus_group verified); /details/apt28 answers 404, so P300 cond 9's 'details/{slug}' applies to families only.
